authority: owner DIR 5 (AM54 score-4 gate, re-scoped after R184-F1: the r178h seal key custody was lost in the recycle; the fresh seal rides the .env-keys-class vault discipline)
claim: c-0296 (the authoring claim; the RUN takes its own claim before execution — Art. 29(b))
question: On a SEALED 24-item invention-shaped holdout (24 domains disjoint from the r176 DEV corpus; every plateau fundamental; every constraint excludes the incumbent mitigation by construction), does the SHIPPED recipe (best-of-N + critique + revise + verifier, 6 calls) beat the COMPUTE-MATCHED single-shot baseline (1 call, same budget ceiling) on blind judged WINS+TIES with Wilson 95% CI LOWER bound > 50%?

arms.A_shipped_recipe: 4 plain draws + critique + revise (6 generator calls — the shipped CHEAP_ARM recipe, verbatim from scripts/r176_invention_run.py's baseline arm; router 2.0.0 policy)
arms.B_compute_matched_single_shot: 1 single-shot draw, max_tokens ceiling equal to the sum ceiling of arm A (compute-matched on budget, not on calls — the baseline gets the SAME total token headroom)

judge: blind two-pass, order-swapped (XY then YX), WIN only when the arm wins its non-swapped presentation on both passes (the r176 instrument verbatim); judge seat tr-deepseek (deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-free via TOKENROUTER, the live measured seat) != generator family (agnes); Art. 26 spread held
scoring_rule_predeclared: Wilson score 95% CI on A-wins+ties over n=24; the gate is the CI LOWER bound > 50% (AM52/AM54: the score moves ONLY on a measured win over a compute-matched baseline)
exclusions: NONE this time — both arms are the recipe's own outputs; dominance ties and plain best-of-N classes do not exist in this design (there is no tournament, no strategy pool — the kill retired them); TIES count toward the arm (wins+ties)

run_protocol.one_run: one run per item; no re-rolls; no tuning of prompts/parameters on any holdout byte before or between items; infra failures typed and resumed (byte-resume), never re-rolled
run_protocol.trigger: run ONCE, only after this prereg is committed AND the run claim is pushed; decrypt ONCE at run start; verify the corpus hash + all 24 item hashes; burn the vault key line after the run
run_protocol.power_note: at n=24 the Wilson lower bound exceeds 0.50 only at >= 15/24 wins+ties (0.625 point); anything less is UNRESOLVED, never failed-passed (Art. 14)

corpus.domain_disjointness: verified programmatically at authoring (zero overlap with the 23 r176 DEV domains)

kill_condition: if the shipped recipe does NOT beat the compute-matched single-shot baseline (CI lower <= 50%), score stays 3 and the recipe is the honest no-worse-than-baseline fallback — no further architecture work without a new owner directive (the kill-ship logic extends: nothing ships that does not win)
